550:t_1:335.en:
$$マオ$$
「Everyone... It's not like me, but let me say something too.」

550:t_1:336.en:
$$マオ$$
「Ever since the $$時獄戦役$$ ended, we've been through hell...」

550:t_1:337.en:
$$桂$$
「That's right... The $$サイデリアル$$ took Earth from us out of nowhere...」

550:t_1:338.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Our desperate charge on $$ラース・バビロン$$ ended in a total defeat...」

550:t_1:339.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「And just when we got thrown to the center of the galaxy, we were sent back to the Solar System for battle after battle.」

550:t_1:340.en:
$$マオ$$
「But losing here is the one thing I absolutely can't stand.」

550:t_1:341.en:
$$マオ$$
「Well... the guy who went on ahead of us is going to be lonely for a while, though.」

550:t_1:342.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Heh... If he's watching us from the other side, he's probably saying any operation where he can't shine should just fail.」

550:t_1:345.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Yeah, yeah... I'm sure I'm the one he resents most.」

550:t_1:346.en:
$$マオ$$
「Then shall we go and betray $$クルツ$$'s expectations?」

550:t_1:349.en:
$$マオ$$
「Let's do it, everyone! To disappoint $$クルツ$$!」

550:t_1:351.en:
$$マオ$$
($$クルツ$$... You turn out to be useful for more than sniping...)

550:t_1:352.en:
$$マオ$$
(I'm going... Sorry, but pray over there that we don't show up...)

550:t_2:3.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

550:t_2:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「No problem! There's no fire, either!」

550:t_2:9.en:
$$サックス$$
「Sorry, $$相良$$... And $$レーバテイン$$ isn't even booted up yet...」

550:t_2:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「Hold on, Lieutenant! I'll stop the bleeding right away!」

550:t_2:11.en:
$$サックス$$
「I'm done for... It's my own body, so I can tell...」

550:t_2:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What are you saying, Boss!」

550:t_2:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「I won't let you die here!」

550:t_2:16.en:
$$サックス$$
「$$レーバテイン$$... Al has his external power cut right now, for the work of adding a data bus to the motion manager.」

550:t_2:17.en:
$$サックス$$
「If Al doesn't wake up, deactivate the line for the added part. If you don't know how, ask $$ピニオン$$...」

550:t_2:19.en:
$$サックス$$
「Never mind that, you say...? What does a soldier do if he doesn't carry out his mission!?」

550:t_2:21.en:
$$サックス$$
「Just as you risk your lives on your missions, I put everything on the line for maintenance...」

550:t_2:22.en:
$$サックス$$
「If you do that procedure from before, you'll have to give up the Emergency Deployment Booster... but the main unit... should... work.」

550:t_2:24.en:
$$サックス$$
「Heh... It ended up like this... but I gave it... everything I had...」

550:t_2:25.en:
$$サックス$$
「I don't... hold a grudge... against anyone...」

550:t_2:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ピニオン$$... Take care of the Lieutenant.」

550:t_2:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「Run the connection test for the Emergency Deployment Booster! Hurry!」

550:t_2:33.en:
$$アル$$
「Before that, I have a question. Lieutenant $$サックス$$...」

550:t_2:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「The Lieutenant... was killed in action.」

550:t_2:35.en:
$$アル$$
「Do you mean that Maintenance Company Commander Lieutenant $$エドワード・サックス$$ has been listed as dead during the operation?」

550:t_2:36.en:
$$宗介$$
「Affirmative. It was from the attack on the ship just now.」

550:t_2:37.en:
$$アル$$
「Understood. Thank you for the explanation.」

550:t_2:38.en:
$$アル$$
「Then I will begin the connection test.」

550:t_2:39.en:
$$宗介$$
「No good... The aileron control line, the secondary system isn't responding.」

550:t_2:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's equipment that was rushed on in a crash job. Defects can't be avoided.」

550:t_2:42.en:
$$アル$$
「No... I mean Lieutenant $$サックス$$.」

550:t_2:44.en:
$$アル$$
「That he was too busy activating me, and neglected to secure his own safety.」

550:t_2:45.en:
$$宗介$$
($$アル$$ feels responsible for $$サックス$$'s death...?)

550:t_2:46.en:
$$宗介$$
(No, however skillfully he can converse with humans, he's a machine...)

550:t_2:47.en:
$$宗介$$
(If it were a question to consider the tactical impact, that would be one thing...)

550:t_2:49.en:
$$宗介$$
「Why are you asking that? Is something worrying you?」

550:t_2:51.en:
$$アル$$
「Now that my activation has succeeded, the drop in combat strength from losing Lieutenant $$サックス$$, a maintenance crewman, is negligible.」

550:t_2:52.en:
$$アル$$
「It is not a situation to be concerned about.」

550:t_2:55.en:
$$アル$$
「I feel a much greater loss.」

550:t_2:57.en:
$$アル$$
「Since the $$アーバレスト$$ days, he looked after me, and was one of the people who knew my body best.」

550:t_2:58.en:
$$アル$$
「He will no longer inspect me, or speak to me, ever again... This is a loss far exceeding the strategic level.」

エドワード・サックス.evidence: Al gives the full given name; glossary has full エドワード・ブルーザー・サックス
